title: Siena no. 11: Donato Acciaiuoli to Lorenzo de' Medici, Rome, 13 June 1478 (ASSi Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 11, DECODE R4800)

documents.shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 11; DECODE R4800 (Concistoro_2308_54)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the sheet; the clear text frames the two cipher blocks.

transcription.source: George Lasry with CTTS (transcription by Claude in his session)
transcription.notes: 393 cipher symbols in 10 lines on P2 (block A 206, block B 187), from the report, not re-measured. George Lasry names accurate transcription as the main obstacle in this fascicle. The project's own 24 Sept transcription (transcripts/no11.txt, 409 tokens, 44 sign names) was not used for the reading.

system.summary: Homophonic substitution: three to five signs for each vowel, one to three for the consonants, a few nulls, and the numerals 80 and 7 written as dotted numbers; no nomenclator (George Lasry's key, 57 distinct signs).
system.sibling_key: none; a Florentine key, not among the Sienese keys of fasc. 1 (R4752 Bichi 1478 tried)
system.notes: Key figure docs/siena11_key.png (report p. 18). Numerals 80 and 7 stand as dotted numbers in the cipher stream.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment on DECODE or in print known; the project's 24 Sept survey left it unread.

conditions.human_role: George Lasry ran the solution in CTTS with Claude (transcription by Claude, key recovered by Claude by crib analysis); this project filed his report and counted his reading.
models: Claude (version not stated in the report)

solution.what: Project survey (siena1421): no. 11 transcribed from the DECODE photographs by agent B (409 tokens, 44 sign names).
Project survey: homophonic annealing on the 409 tokens; no convergence.
Project survey: Sienese key R4752 ('Cifra de m. Antonio Bichi 1478 Rom.') compared; does not fit. Gabbrielli's Florentine key index (Ilardi reel 58) has no key for Donato Acciaiuoli in 1478.
George Lasry's session: 393 cipher symbols transcribed by Claude in CTTS.
George Lasry with CTTS and Claude: key recovered by Claude by crib analysis from the ciphertext; 57 signs, homophonic; both blocks read, about 90% certain; two encipherer's slips marked.
This project counted George Lasry's reading: 357 of 381 plaintext letters (93.7%) in words without a query mark; one sign lost in a hole.

validation.notes: contributed reading: George Lasry's sign-level CTTS transcription and key are not in the repository, so no token alignment can be scored

outcome.method_basis: The report says the key was recovered by Claude by crib analysis from the ciphertext; no decipherment, plaintext or filed key exists for this letter.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Counted on George Lasry's reading (lasry_report.md, cipher passages only): 357 of 381 plaintext letters and numerals in words without a query mark; he gives 'about 90 % certain'.

gaps.item: one sign lost in a hole in block A
six doubtful words (di?, non?, da?, s?ervigi, no?, Bacio?), 24 of 381 letters
gaps.detail: single-occurrence signs and two encipherer's slips in a 393-sign text

gaps.item: whether the Gonzaga condotta was concluded
gaps.detail: Rubinstein, Lettere di Lorenzo de' Medici III (1977), not online here

credits.note: Key recovered ciphertext-only with CTTS and Claude (transcription by Claude, crib analysis); reading, translation, context (report pp. 18-19).
